description: This file defines the Doctrine ORM entity class `BuzzLikeOnComment` representing 'like' interactions on comments within the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin. It includes annotations for ORM mapping, properties for comment, employee, and timestamp, and methods for accessing these properties.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnComment
classes.description: Entity class representing a 'like' on a comment in the Buzz module; manages references to the comment, liking employee, and timestamp.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the like.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the like.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Associates a comment with this like.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee object who liked the comment.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee with this like.

methods.name: getLikedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the like was made, in UTC.

methods.name: setLikedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the timestamp to the current UTC time.
